Class AutoStoreItemEvent

java.lang.Object
net.okocraft.box.api.event.BoxEvent
net.okocraft.box.feature.autostore.event.AutoStoreItemEvent
@NotNullByDefault public final class AutoStoreItemEvent extends BoxEvent
A notification fired when AutoStore takes an item from a pickup or a drop. It is delivered on the thread handling the operation, after the item is removed from its source.
